the development and implementation of a model that is designed to enhance the well-being of children and families through the provision of information and support to parents.
how to create a system that is responsive to families' needs and is able to support and integrate families into their communities.
how the ParentLink model of support and information can be applied to a wide range of parenting issues and how it can be integrated with other programs and policies.
